title: tracker gates --json
description: A gates dry run in which every gate passed (DESIGN.md §2.4, §3). It changes nothing. Once every gate passes, the triggers run, as on a submit (DESIGN.md §2.5), and holds lists the ones that would hold a submit now. When a gate fails, it exits 2 and prints the error shape instead, with id, result, gates and failures, and no trigger runs.

status.description: The item's state. Only an in-progress item can be submitted, but the gates run in any state.

gates.description: Every gate that submit runs, in order, each with whether it passed.

secs.description: For G3 and G4, which run checks: how long their checks took together, in seconds.

triggers.description: Every trigger that ran, with whether it fired. A trigger switched off in the project's review.disabled doesn't run and isn't listed.

holds.description: Every trigger that fired, with the message saying why: what would hold a submit in review now. Empty when a submit would verify the item automatically. Each one is also in triggers, with fired true. Nothing is written: the item's own holds change only on a submit.
